findings.text: LocalFlags() no longer includes global flags from flag.CommandLine for root commands. The original code had explicit logic to copy global flags when !c.HasParent(), but this was removed. A root command with globally registered flags will not return them via LocalFlags().

LocalFlags() now caches c.lflags across calls instead of building a fresh FlagSet each time. If flags are added to the command after the first LocalFlags() call, subsequent calls will return stale results missing the newly added flags.

0.reason: The new LocalFlags() removes the explicit flag.CommandLine copy for root commands, so globally registered flags are no longer returned.

1.reason: LocalFlags() re-visits c.flags and c.PersistentFlags() each call and adds missing flags, so newly added flags are not stale.
